11. Change of Branch 
11.1 Meritorious B.Tech, Int. MSc and BTech- MTech dual degree students who have secured CGPA 
of 8.5 or more (without any backlog) at the end of first year are eligible to opt for change of branch, 
of their choice, subject to following conditions: 
i. Change of branch is subject to availability of vacant seats and subject to the condition 
that the consequent vacancy created in the parent department, due to branch change, 
should not be more than 5% of actual existing strength.  
ii. 5% of vacancy is to be calcu lated based on existing strength. Decimal figures to be 
rounded up to the nearest integer (E.g. 1.5 = 2 and 1.49 = 1). 
iii. There is no option to revert the change of branch once allotted.  
iv. The branch change will be strictly based on CGPA only and no other crit erion will be 
adopted. 
v. In case of a tie in CGPA for allotting Branch Change, the JEE Main rank (CRL) will be 
considered.
